(async()=>{const {useStudio}=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const {listAssistantFiles,getAssistantFile}=await import('/src/studio/assistant/attachmentFiles.ts');const {readAttachment}=await import('/src/studio/assistant/readAttachment.ts');const project=useStudio.getState().job.id,files=await listAssistantFiles(project);const large=files.find(f=>f.size===500*1024*1024);if(!large)throw Error('Large file missing');const result=await readAttachment(project,large.id,1,499*1024*1024);if(!result.content[0].text.includes('MASSIVE-FILE-QA'))throw Error('Tail retrieval failed');try{await getAssistantFile('foreign-project',large.id);throw Error('Foreign file leaked')}catch(e){if(e.message!=='File not found in this project.')throw e}const previews=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-attachments img')];if(previews.length!==20)throw Error('20 previews missing');if(previews.some(i=>i.src.length>260030))throw Error('Preview too large');window.__largeProof={project,large,files:files.length,previews:previews.length,previewCharacters:previews.reduce((n,i)=>n+i.src.length,0)};return window.__largeProof})()
